def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Locate the solid dividing line, ignoring uniform background margins.
    candidates = []
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != grid[0][0]:
            candidates.append(("h", r, grid[r][0]))
    for c in range(1, w - 1):
        if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)):
            candidates.append(("v", c, grid[0][c]))

    # Prefer a line that divides the grid into equal-sized panels.
    for orient, k, sep in candidates:
        if orient == "h" and k == h // 2:
            top, bottom = grid[:k], grid[k + 1:]
            shared = set(x for row in top for x in row) & set(x for row in bottom for x in row)
            shared.discard(sep)
            if shared:
                color = max(shared, key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in top + bottom for v in row))
                return [[color] * w for _ in range(min(len(top), len(bottom)))]
        if orient == "v" and k == w // 2:
            left = [row[:k] for row in grid]
            right = [row[k + 1:] for row in grid]
            shared = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
            shared.discard(sep)
            if shared:
                color = max(shared, key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in left + right for v in row))
                return [[color] * min(k, w - k - 1) for _ in range(h)]

    # Fallback: use the central solid divider.
    for orient, k, sep in candidates:
        if orient == "h":
            top, bottom = grid[:k], grid[k + 1:]
            shared = set(x for row in top for x in row) & set(x for row in bottom for x in row)
            shared.discard(sep)
            color = next(iter(shared))
            return [[color] * w for _ in range(min(len(top), len(bottom)))]
        left = [row[:k] for row in grid]
        right = [row[k + 1:] for row in grid]
        shared = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
        shared.discard(sep)
        color = next(iter(shared))
        return [[color] * min(k, w - k - 1) for _ in range(h)]

             if all(grid[i][j] == grid[0][j] for i in range(h)))
